# Bar

The one bar: a horizontal meter that holds one fill or several blocks, in five thicknesses.

`NomNom.Bar` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.Bar />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.Bar"></x-import>
```

## Notes

The one bar. One fill or several blocks, xs to xl.

## Props (BarProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number \| null` | Single fill: 0–max; null = empty ("Not rated"). Ignored when `segments` is given. |
| `segments` | `BarSegment[]` | Several blocks, each sized by its share of the sum — or of `max`, which leaves a remainder of track. |
| `max` | `number` | @default 100 for a single fill; the sum of the segments otherwise. |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | Thickness 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 / 12 px (spacing-1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5 / 3). @default 'md' |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name. A single fill defaults to '<value> out of <max>'; segments need one. |

### BarSegment

Read-only bar: primary fill over the track.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` * | `number` |  |
| `reaction` | `'inedible' \| 'bad' \| 'meh' \| 'good' \| 'great' \| 'amazing'` | Paints the step's reaction fill. |
| `color` | `string` | Any other colour token, e.g. 'var(--chart-series2)'. |
| `label` | `string` | Tooltip text; the visible key is SegmentedBar's job. |
